protocol.openings: uniform legal random prefix; target occupied 16+(family mod 4); at least two legal choices; entire ancestry from occupied 12 excluded against available hashed historical index and all previously admitted families
protocol.scope: Engineering strength screen. No new training, no independent production-promotion claim. Historical index has previously disclosed role limitations; incidental late convergence remains possible.
protocol.order: family ascending; budgets [80,300] for first 128 then [80]; native colors [1,-1] for even family, reversed for odd family

statistics.interval: two-sided paired Student 95%; bootstrap percentile sensitivity; two primary controls use one-sided alpha .025 each, descriptive matched 300-minus-80 contrast
statistics.numericalTail: same Student test; positive survival-density quadrature with u=1/x, 32768 Simpson intervals; independent analytic/Python checks

protocol.warmup: each process: disclosed engineering roots, depths 3 and 5, P on both backends; before each pair reference P depth 3 and native P depth 3 on fixed engineering middle root
protocol.cancellation: kill native process; discard unfinished request; retain durable per-move game checkpoint
protocol.timing: same elapsed budget; fresh Date.now UTC deadline sent at client entry (at most 1 ms conservative timestamp quantization); native converts once to remaining steady-clock duration; output transport counted in observed overruns; native clock checked every 64 nodes
